==In the manga==
===Pokémon Adventures===
 ]]
Both male and female Clerks have appeared in Pokémon Adventures, although their roles are minor.

==== ====
A male and a female Clerk appeared in An Odd Speech, listening to Ghetsis' speech.

A female Clerk briefly appeared in Nimbasa City in Unraveling Mysteries.

A male Clerk and his superior was seen in Drawing Bridges amongst the Trainers waiting to get to cross the Driftveil Drawbridge.

A female Clerk and a superior appeared in Dream a Little Dream as a participant.

==== ====
In Truth and the Mastermind Behind Team Skull, a female Clerk was seen running away in horror from the Ultra Beasts that showed up in Alola.

==== ====
In Chomp!! It's Dracovish, a male Clerk who was a in disguise was sent with his cohorts to Route 9 Tunnel to dispose of a wild that suddenly Dynamaxed. The Dracovish was saved by Marvin, who used his Sniffler to stun everyone long enough for him to catch Dracovish and escape. Afterward, they reported their failure to Oleana and were ordered to stand by in Wyndon.
